messages:
incident-bot: Postmortem posted for INC-2026-51: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-51 — follow-ups: customer note, RCA sharing policy, recurring-pattern ticket.

laura_comms: Drafting the customer-facing note now. Need an agreed 1-paragraph blurb + 2-line timeline. Prefer plain language, avoid product-internal terms.

cheng_sre: Quick draft — please tweak: 
```
On 2026-03-14 between 14:05 and 14:18 UTC, some API requests returned 5xx errors due to a delay in scaling additional worker processes. We applied mitigations that restored normal service within 13 minutes. We have implemented changes to reduce the chance of recurrence and are monitoring. For a full timeline or technical report, contact support.
```

laura_comms: Good start. Change "delay in scaling additional worker processes" -> "a short scaling delay". Also add: "Customers may have seen intermittent failures; retries should have reduced impact."

cheng_sre: Updated the blurb per above.

sofia_prod: For transparency we should publish: 1) short blurb on status page, 2) three-bullet timeline, 3) offer full RCA on request after redaction review. Do not attach full RCA publicly.

legal_team: Agree with controlled sharing. We will redact customer-identifying and internal control details before release. SLA: 48-72 hours for redaction review depending on queue.

laura_comms: Proposed public timeline bullets: - 14:05 — error rate increased - 14:08 — mitigation applied (routing + retries) - 14:18 — service returned to normal; monitoring ongoing

ali_dev: Noting that this mirrors two prior incidents in the last 60 days. I'm creating a recurring-pattern ticket P-789 in the postmortem tracker and attaching a heatmap. Owner: ops_tracker (assign to cheng_sre) due in 7 days.

ops_tracker: Ticket P-789 created: https://tracker.internal/P-789 — assigned cheng_sre, due 7d. Added links to the three PMs.

laura_comms: For the customer note line about RCA sharing, propose: "A technical incident report is available on request after a short review to remove operationally sensitive details. If you need the report, reply or contact support@redwood.com."

cheng_sre: +1. Also will open PR to tighten autoscaler thresholds: PR #4123. I'll link in the tracker when ready.

laura_comms: Owners & deadlines (please confirm): - Draft outreach copy: laura_comms — due EOD +1 (2361096276) - Tech sign-off on copy: cheng_sre — within 4 hours of draft - Redaction review: legal_team — 48-72h - Publish status page & timeline: sofia_prod — coordinate with comms once sign-off done - Recurring-pattern ticket: ops_tracker — created, owner cheng_sre, due +7d - Autoscaler PR: ali_dev/cheng_sre — PR #4123, link when up

cheng_sre: Confirmed. I'll do tech sign-off and raise PR today.

laura_comms: I'll post the draft to #customer-outreach when ready and ping here for final sign-off. Will include suggested customer-facing blurb + timeline bullets.

incident-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 72 hours (2361002500).

ops_tracker: Added query used to validate recurrence: `service:api AND status>=500 | rollup(count(), 1d) | last(90d)` and attached the result snapshot to P-789.

legal_team: We'll start redaction prep; reach out if you want priority handling for specific customers.

laura_comms: Thanks all — will update this thread with the outreach draft. :sparkles:
